# 🛡️ Governed Agentic AI - SOC Alert Triage
**UI alert → Intake guardrails → 5 AI agents → Decision Engine → A / H / E / X → Human approval**  ·  **A** = Autonomous  ·  **H** = Human-in-the-Loop  ·  **E** = Escalation  ·  **X** = Exception

# 1 · INTAKE & GUARDRAILS
**A** · Validate alert, block prompt injection, redact PII, pseudonymise user, allow-listed models only

# 2 · SPECIALIST AI AGENTS
**A** · Top row = data tools (mock SIEM / Threat-Intel / CMDB).  Bottom row = LLM agents (open models). Evidence-only, JSON-only, retry ×3

# 3 · DECISION
**A** · 50% rule score + 50% AI score, hallucination & schema checks, playbook allow-list

← from Summary Agent

# 5 · HUMAN-IN-THE-LOOP  [H]
Workflow pauses for analyst approve / reject / escalate. Containment never automatic. 60-min SLA → auto-escalate
